page_title: HEI 0-0 BOC | Heidenheim v Bochum 26/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Booking. Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) receives a caution from the referee.
90+3' Florian Pick (Heidenheim) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
90+2' Florian Pick (Heidenheim) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. The ball is out of play and Heidenheim manage to earn a corner.
90+2' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) tackles a bit over-zealously and Felix Zwayer blows for a foul. Heidenheim will take a free kick.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
88' Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
85' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
81' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
80' Jan-Niklas Beste comes off the pitch to be replaced by Florian Pick (Heidenheim).
80' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Omar Haktab Traore is replaced by Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim).
79' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) heads on.
77' Felix Zwayer shows a yellow card to Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) for his blatant foul.

77' Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the top right corner, but Manuel Riemann shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
76' The game has come to an end for Takuma Asano. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum).
76' The attendance is 15000.
76' Takuma Asano (Bochum) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was!

75' Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
73' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Manuel Riemann, who smothers the ball.
73' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
72' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Marnon Busch (Heidenheim). Heidenheim force their opponents to concede a corner.
71' 5:8 – the total goal attempt statistics. Shots on target – 2:2.
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Philipp Forster (Bochum) comes onto the pitch so that Lukas Daschner can be given a rest.
66' Frank Schmidt has decided to substitute Jan Schoppner and he is replaced by Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim).
66' Adrian Beck goes off the pitch and Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) comes on.
66' Frank Schmidt has decided to make a change. Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim) replaces Eren Dinkci.
65' Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Felix Zwayer had an easy-decision to make.
63' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
62' The corner from Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is hurriedly cleared.
61' Bernardo (Bochum) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the right side of the goal. His effort is blocked by Kevin Muller with a brilliant diving save!
60' Heidenheim are ruled offside.
58' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) receives a yellow card.
58' The resulting corner from Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) is cleared.

58' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the right post. Manuel Riemann guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.

57' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Lukas Daschner (Bochum) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
55' Lukas Daschner (Bochum) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
54' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Bochum will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
53' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the top right corner, but Kevin Muller keeps it out with an amazing save.
51' The whistle blows and Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) is booked for an infringement.
51' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
51' Tempers flare after Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) commits a foul. He receives a yellow card for his bad challenge and surely must be relieved at not receiving a red card.
49' The linesman signals that Anthony Losilla (Bochum) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
49' Lukas Daschner (Bochum) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
49' The linesman points to the corner flag, Bochum are going to take it. Good defending. Kevin Stoger (Bochum) tries to find Philipp Hofmann inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
47' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) sends a chip pass into the box, but Kevin Muller is quickest to intercept the ball.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' Lukas Daschner (Bochum) sends a cross into the box, but Kevin Muller comes off his line to gather the ball.
43' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
43' Lukas Daschner (Bochum) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
41' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
40' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Kevin Muller intercepts the ball.

38' Poor effort! The corner picks out Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) completely unmarked in the centre of the box. He has time to pick his spot with the header but makes a mess of it, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
37' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
35' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) offside.
35' The corner kick from Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
34' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. Heidenheim win a corner.
33' Takuma Asano (Bochum) meets a perfect cross on the edge of the box and rips a shot that goes well wide of the right post.
29' Lukas Daschner (Bochum) picks up a rebound, moves into space and fires a shot at goal from long range that rises sharply and goes high over the bar.
28' Jan Schoppner puts Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) in the clear, but he completely fluffs his lines from mid-range and sends a shot well wide of the left post.
27' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lukas Daschner (Bochum) was quite harsh and Felix Zwayer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
25' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) receives a pass, beats an opponent and tries a long-range shot. It's a weak effort towards the top of the net and Manuel Riemann easily plucks the ball out of the air.

24' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
24' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for a foul. Bochum have been awarded a free kick.
21' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just wide of the right post.
18' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
16' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
15' It looks like Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) saw red with that tackle. Felix Zwayer won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
13' A spell of possession for Heidenheim in an attempt to control the game.
9' Takuma Asano (Bochum) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
6' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
4' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
3' Takuma Asano (Bochum) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
2' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just wide of the right post.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Heidenheim will take the kick-off.
Felix Zwayer will referee today's match.
